Cost of *wrong* response ::: ::: aside See [Tourangeau and Yan (2007)](https://psycnet.apa.org/doi/10.1037/0033-2909.133.5.859) and [Blair et al (2020)](https://doi.org/10.1017/S0003055420000374) for extensive discussions ::: . . .   {{< fa arrow-right >}} Presence of others meets all criteria ## What we know so far ::: incremental - **Presence of enumerators:** Political questions are sensitive - **Household surveys:** Presence of parents/spouses shapes answers - **Afrobarometer:** Family and non-family affect responses and *don't know* rates [(Zimbalist 2022)](https://doi.org/10.1080/13645579.2021.1886397) ::: ## This project 1.
